gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (Japan)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 1 MiB flash (padded 262144 -> 1048576 with 0xFF)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 1048576 --stem 'Rittai Picross (Japan)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 1048576-byte chip (padded 262144 -> 1048576 with 0xFF) and writes each core's file
